title: Naive quartic cutoff compatibility fails and Wick ordering gives only a martingale interaction candidate

renormalization_boundary.variance_growth: For a three-dimensional massive free field cutoff, C_N=E(phi_N(x)^2) is a positive mode sum that diverges with N; hence E integral phi_N^4 equals 3 Vol C_N^2 and diverges
renormalization_boundary.conditional_expectation: Writing phi_M=phi_N+eta with new-mode variance Delta C, E(phi_M^4 conditional on F_N)=phi_N^4+6 Delta C phi_N^2+3 Delta C squared
renormalization_boundary.obstruction: The bare quartic multiplication forms are not projectively compatible: integrating out new modes generates cutoff-dependent quadratic and vacuum terms
renormalization_boundary.wick_candidate: The Hermite polynomial :phi_N^4:_{C_N}=phi_N^4-6 C_N phi_N^2+3 C_N squared satisfies the martingale identity E(:phi_M^4:_{C_M} conditional on F_N)=:phi_N^4:_{C_N}
renormalization_boundary.operator_boundary: Wick martingale compatibility does not make the cutoff forms nonnegative, semibounded uniformly, closable in the limit or convergent in resolvent sense. Those estimates and any further counterterms are separate constructive-field-theory obligations
renormalization_boundary.pde_boundary: The Wick identity is probabilistic cutoff algebra and supplies no estimate for K1413's electric-current or pointwise radial-coefficient leakage
